senses.gloss: f. (= אִי דָא, v. אוּ a. דָּא) this, the same.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 3:8:2">Y. Erub. III, 21ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הדא אמרה אי א׳ אי א׳</he> this proves this is this, this is that, i.e. it is the same. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 3:8:2">Ib.</cite> <he>היא הדא היא הדא</he>.]
